title: Create clear beginner, researcher and developer navigation
objective: People can understand the product and choose an appropriate starting route.
outcome: Every navigation destination resolves to useful content; disabled features are not promoted as primary actions. Claims match the accepted generation; a beginner can distinguish finding a source from obtaining restricted data. At 320px and 390px menus remain usable without overflow and every entry has a descriptive accessible name. plan_research remains disabled. worker/index.mjs does not import enrichment. HTTP 200 is not a completed research task. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.
